nodes.label: Pinecone Course Memory
nodes.rationale: Indexes course slide PDFs, free ebook, grad/rehab PDFs, and official LMS caption transcripts for course rules, definitions, and setups.

nodes.label: Obsidian Decision Vault
nodes.rationale: Holds curated Nova decisions, roadmap, library inventory, and keyword search over official transcripts on disk.

nodes.label: Recall Router
nodes.rationale: Routes Nova/build/automate questions to Obsidian first, course/setup questions to Pinecone first, ambiguous queries to both with labeled grounding.

nodes.label: Official LMS Captions
nodes.rationale: Default transcript source for Pinecone indexing because it matches the Wistia player subtitle track with video-aligned timestamps.

nodes.label: Trust Order for Automation Advice
nodes.rationale: Obsidian Active-Strategy and Roadmap rank highest, then Pinecone course chunks with citations, then model prior knowledge which must never override explicit decisions.

nodes.label: downloads/warrior-trading-* Canonical Roots
nodes.rationale: Single on-disk library under downloads/warrior-trading-slides, resources, caption-notes, and videos avoids duplicate trees and confusion during ingest/recall.

nodes.label: Five Pillars and Gap and Go Spec
nodes.norm_label: five pillars and gap and go spec

nodes.label: Five Pillars Scoring
nodes.rationale: All five pillars must pass: price $2-20, change >=10%, RVOL >=5x, catalyst, float <=20M; missing data fails closed.

nodes.label: Gap and Go Setup
nodes.rationale: Mechanical morning play: Five Pillars gate, 9:30-10:00 ET window, break of premarket high, entry/stop/target math with would_execute hard-coded False.

nodes.label: Signal Only Safety Property
nodes.rationale: Strategy endpoints never place orders; would_execute is False on every code path by design so signal modules cannot accidentally grow execution paths.

nodes.label: Active Strategy Gap and Go
nodes.rationale: Primary setup chosen for Warrior/Ross momentum family because PM high break in 9:30-10 window is most mechanical and matches Nova gappers plus IBKR discovery.

nodes.label: Alpaca-Only Features
nodes.rationale: News, charts/OHLCV bars, RVOL, after-hours scanner, HOD Momo real-time feed, L2 tape recorder, and health badge still depend on Alpaca with no full IBKR replacement yet.

nodes.label: Nova OS Phases P0-P10
nodes.rationale: Phased plan from baseline through archive, replay, and P10 live-readiness review; all verified with NO-GO for auto_live.

nodes.label: Warrior Ross Momentum Model
nodes.rationale: Edge from selection of low-float high-RVOL catalyst names plus risk asymmetry and machine-enforced discipline rather than discretionary tape reading.

nodes.label: Automation Phases A-F
nodes.rationale: Watchlist, setup triggers, risk engine, paper IBKR executor, journal go/no-go, and L2 learning record-first pipeline all implemented.

nodes.label: IBKR Orders Locked On Live Gateway
nodes.norm_label: ibkr orders locked on live gateway

nodes.label: IBKR Safety Gates
nodes.rationale: backend/ibkr/safety.py gates all spends via IBKR_ENABLED, IBKR_ORDERS_ENABLED, and IBKR_LIVE_TRADING_CONFIRMED with safe defaults false.

nodes.label: L2 SQLite WAL Recorder
nodes.rationale: Extend l2.db with batched WAL inserts for IBKR depth snapshots and Alpaca tape on watched symbols only; Parquet deferred until volume proves SQLite insufficient.

nodes.label: News Impact Classification
nodes.rationale: Rules-first moved_price, attention_only, no_effect, insufficient_data classes with thresholds in NEWS_IMPACT_* constants; sentiment is informational only.

nodes.label: Nova OS decide() Gate Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Ordered gates from session/regime through Five Pillars, setup recognition, ticket math, catalyst quality, microstructure, and execution policy producing BUY|NO_BUY|WAIT with reason codes.

nodes.label: Nova OS Control Modes
nodes.rationale: signal shows checklist only; confirm stages approval; auto_paper places IBKR paper brackets; auto_live blocked behind explicit env confirm and metrics bar.

nodes.label: NO-GO for auto_live
nodes.rationale: P10 review rejects automatic live order placement due to insufficient paper sample, unproven expectancy/adherence, and auto_live rejected in control_mode code.

nodes.label: Nova OS
nodes.rationale: Auditable trading decision and operations layer combining scanner facts, strategy rules, risk, microstructure, and control mode into explicit BUY|WAIT|NO_BUY with evidence and learning loop.

nodes.label: IBKR Scanner Discovery
nodes.rationale: Primary live discovery via IBKR reqScannerSubscription matching Ross top-gapper workflow; reject Alpaca SIP and free IEX for live scanning.

nodes.label: Single downloads/ Library Decision
nodes.rationale: Merge unique files into downloads/warrior-trading-* only; Obsidian holds inventory pointers; Pinecone holds searchable text; no parallel docs/warrior-trading tree.
